column3: Close to the Greek; “nard” is rendered “spikenard.”
NKJV adds “And another said, ‘Is it I?’,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has only “Surely not I?”
NKJV names “Jesus” and includes “eat,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “Take; this is My body.”
NKJV has “the new covenant,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “the covenant.”
NKJV includes “because of Me this night,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “You will all fall away.”
